## Change and purpose

Describe the implemented component and how it supports the Kitenge project.

## Graphics explanation

Identify the algorithm, explain its inputs and output, and list relevant assumptions.
Describe which calculations you implemented yourselves.

## Verification

Record the commands run and their results. Include any meaningful edge cases checked.

## Visual evidence

Attach a rendered image or screenshot for graphics changes, with its generation command.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The branch builds with the documented C++17 commands.
- [ ] Changes use the shared types and follow `workfile.md`.
- [ ] Algorithm checks cover the relevant edge cases.
- [ ] Documentation describes progress accurately and states known limitations.
- [ ] Build files and generated working images have not been committed.
- [ ] A teammate has reviewed the implementation and its explanation.
